messages.description: Messages: { id, message, action?, countdown? }. action is { label, href?, onClick? }; countdown is { to, label? }.

id.description: Remembers dismissal in localStorage under uikit-announcement:<id>. Change it to show a new campaign again.

open.description: Controlled visibility. Stored dismissal is ignored when set.

onOpenChange.description: Called with false when the visitor dismisses the bar.

index.description: Controlled index of the visible message.

onIndexChange.description: Called when rotation or the arrows change the message.

interval.description: Milliseconds each message stays before the next one.

autoPlay.description: Rotates automatically. Off when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

controls.description: Shows previous, next, and the pause ring when there are several messages. Off by default: only the close button shows and messages still rotate.

tone.description: Muted surface, or foreground-colored bar with background text.

onAction.description: Called when a message's call to action is pressed, after its own onClick.

onCountdownEnd.description: Called once when a message's countdown reaches zero.
